run_rtmdet_small_training: run the RTMDet small instance segmentation model training on COCO using this config file
configure_rtmdet_backbone: configure the RTMDet small backbone with deepen factor 0.33 and widen factor 0.5
set_train_pipeline: set up the two-stage training pipeline with CachedMosaic and MixUp augmentation for stage 1
configure_ema_hook: configure the EMA hook with ExpMomentumEMA momentum 0.0002 for model weight smoothing
switch_pipeline_epoch: switch from stage 1 to stage 2 training pipeline at epoch 280 using PipelineSwitchHook
